question: Which among the following is not an example of Thallophyta?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marchantia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Marchantia** is not an example of Thallophyta.
 
• Marchantia is a liverwort that is considered to be one of the most primitive bryophytes.
 
• It is a heterothallic plant with the antheridiophore and archegoniophore on different thalli.
 
• They reproduce sexually to form the sporophyte.
